purpose: Local style selection before replacing production images

styles.title: Clinical documentary
styles.description: Experienced faculty, candid teaching and realistic clinical spaces.
styles.alt: AI-generated editorial photograph of experienced clinicians discussing clinical education in an academic teaching room.
styles.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: representative image for a localhost art-direction comparison for a clinical partnership page using Attio Mono.
Primary request: convey professionalism and substantial clinical-education experience.
Composition: landscape 4:3, central subject safe for both a 4:3 hero frame and a 16:10 course-card crop. No embedded text.
Constraints: fictional generic setting and people, no identifiable institution or real provider relationship; no logos, branding, readable badges, signage, patient records, readable screens or watermark. No patients, needles, surgery, plastic anatomy models, posed handshakes or exaggerated smiles.
Scene: an experienced female consultant in her late fifties and an experienced male clinician in his fifties guiding an adult medical graduate in a genuine-looking academic hospital case-conference room. Natural professional conversation around a table, a plain closed folder and a blurred neutral presentation area behind them. Faculty in understated clinical attire with white coats, no gimmicky props.
Style: observational documentary photography for an established medical university's annual report; believable skin texture, mature faces, natural hands, composed attentive expressions. 35mm eye-level medium-wide photograph with context and crisp detail, restrained neutral whites, stone and charcoal with faint clinical-blue accents. Natural window light and balanced realistic shadows. Avoid over-soft stock photography, artificial glow, overexposure, smoothing and lifestyle advertising.

styles.title: Institutional architecture
styles.description: Established academic settings, strong architectural composition and fewer people.
styles.alt: AI-generated architectural photograph of a generic academic medical centre with faculty walking through a teaching wing.
styles.prompt:

Asset type: representative image for a localhost art-direction comparison for a clinical partnership page using Attio Mono.

Constraints: fictional generic setting and people, no identifiable institution or real provider relationship; no logos, branding, readable badges, signage, patient records, readable screens or watermark. No patients, needles, surgery, plastic anatomy models, posed handshakes or exaggerated smiles.
Scene: a dignified contemporary academic medical centre's teaching wing, photographed through a spacious corridor toward a small glass-walled seminar room. Two experienced faculty members in professional attire walk together in the middle distance. Generic institutional architecture, limestone, restrained warm wood, glass and dark metal, carefully maintained and purposeful rather than luxurious.
Style: precise architectural editorial photography for a respected healthcare institution, straight verticals, balanced depth, 28mm lens, natural daylight, crisp geometry and authentic materials. Neutral stone, white, grey and charcoal palette. People are small in the composition; the place establishes competence and permanence. Avoid hospital hotel styling, dramatic luxury lobby, futuristic architecture, bright colour accents and stock-photo glow.

styles.title: Faculty portrait
styles.description: An authoritative senior educator, composed as an institutional editorial portrait.
styles.alt: AI-generated formal editorial portrait of an experienced clinical educator in an academic office.

Scene: a fictional experienced female medical professor in her early sixties, in a tailored dark professional jacket and light blouse, seated at a quiet academic office desk with a plain closed folder. Waist-up, thoughtful assured expression, looking slightly off camera, natural age lines and hands. styles.alt: AI-generated black-and-white photograph of senior clinical faculty discussing a case at an academic teaching conference.
styles.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: representative image for a localhost art-direction comparison for a clinical partnership page using Attio Mono.

Scene: two experienced medical faculty members, a grey-haired man and a woman in her fifties, discussing a teaching case in a mature academic hospital conference room with one adult graduate listening. Medium-wide documentary moment, quiet concentration, authentic posture and simple folders, context visible.

styles.title: Architectural ink illustration
styles.description: A restrained editorial drawing that communicates an academic setting without stock photography.
styles.alt: AI-generated ink illustration of experienced faculty in an academic medical teaching space.
styles.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: representative image for a localhost art-direction comparison for a clinical partnership page using Attio Mono.
Primary request: convey professionalism and substantial clinical-education experience.
Composition: landscape 4:3, central subject safe for both a 4:3 hero frame and a 16:10 course-card crop. No embedded text.
Constraints: fictional generic setting and people, no identifiable institution or real provider relationship; no logos, branding, readable badges, signage, patient records, readable screens or watermark. No patients, needles, surgery, plastic anatomy models, posed handshakes or exaggerated smiles.
Scene: an experienced clinical educator and two adult colleagues in a dignified academic medical teaching room, large windows and a simple conference table, framed with visible institutional architecture. Small, natural figures in the environment, calm professional discussion.
Style: sophisticated architectural ink-and-wash editorial illustration for a medical university publication. Fine charcoal ink contours, deliberate crosshatching, restrained grey washes, large areas of clean off-white paper, precise perspective and mature observational drawing. Subtle paper grain, no colour other than grayscale. Professional and established, not playful. Landscape composition with central people and architectural framing. Avoid cartoon faces, children’s-book style, flat corporate vector blobs, anatomy diagrams, 3D rendering, bright colours and text.
